name: glimtpanel
description: Ett nettleservindu som viser hva alle serverne dine gjør akkurat nå.

scripts.dev:hub: node scripts/env.mjs --require GLIMT_MONGO_URI -- dotnet watch --project apps/glimt-hub/src/Glimt.Hub --non-interactive
scripts.dev:web: node scripts/web-config.mjs && npm --workspace apps/glimt-web run start
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:hub && npm run test:agent
scripts.lint: npm --workspace apps/glimt-web run lint && dotnet format apps/glimt-hub/Glimt.Hub.slnx --verify-no-changes
scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/glimt-web run build && dotnet build apps/glimt-hub/Glimt.Hub.slnx -c Release && npm --workspace apps/glimt-site run build
